title: Free Inference
tagline: Free AI & LLM inference you can build with: an API key, a CLI login, or inference bundled inside a coding tool or builder. Speech-to-text, voice synthesis, code, vision, and reasoning. The test is whether you can ship an artifact you keep — code, an app, an audio file, a site, a design, an agent, a skill. Chat-only free tiers are excluded on purpose.

providers.name: OpenCode Zen
providers.notes: OpenCode Zen offers 12 free models with 256K–1M context (including Big Pickle, Jev 1.13, Flint 40B, and Crouton). No credit card required. Free-tier prompts are retained for model training.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.notes: OpenRouter offers 13 permanently free models (:free suffix) with 64K–500K context, translating to 50 requests/day (1,000 requests/day with + purchased credits). No credit card required. Upstream model availability determines live rate limits.

providers.name: Google AI Studio (Gemini API)
providers.notes: Google AI Studio offers 16 free models with up to 1M context, translating to 15–30 requests/minute (up to 1,500 requests/day per model). No credit card required. Free-tier prompts and outputs are retained for model training.

providers.name: Groq
providers.notes: Groq offers 13 free models (9 LLMs, 2 Whisper STT, 2 Orpheus TTS), translating to up to 14,400 text requests/day and 2,000 audio transcriptions/day (~8 hours/day). No credit card required. Limits are pooled at organization level.

providers.name: Cerebras
providers.notes: Cerebras offers $5 trial credit across 2 models (gpt-oss-120b, qwen-3.8-27b with 8K context cap), translating to 1M tokens/day at 2,000+ tokens/sec. Credit card required. Trial credits expire in 30 days.

providers.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
providers.notes: Cloudflare Workers AI offers ~80 free models (including Llama 3.3 70B, DeepSeek-R1 distills, Whisper, and FLUX), translating to 10,000 neurons/day (~hundreds of queries or audio minutes). No credit card required. Hard stop at 10,000 neurons until 00:00 UTC daily reset.

models.name: ~80 free models (Llama 3.x/4, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek-R1 distills, FLUX, Whisper, BGE embeddings)

providers.name: Hugging Face
providers.notes: Hugging Face offers free serverless inference on popular open models (up to ~300 requests/hour), with 10–30s cold starts on low-traffic weights. No credit card required. Rate limits throttle dynamically based on shared cluster load.

providers.name: Mistral La Plateforme
providers.notes: Mistral offers free evaluation API access across 4 models (including Codestral and Mistral Small), translating to 1B free tokens/month on Experiment tier. Phone verification required; no credit card required. Restricted to evaluation and non-production prototyping.

providers.name: SambaNova Cloud
providers.notes: SambaNova Cloud offers 5 free models (including DeepSeek-V3.2, Llama 3.3 70B, and Gemma 4 31B) with 128K context, translating to 10–30 requests/minute. No credit card required. Preview models may rotate or unpublish without advance notice.

providers.name: NVIDIA NIM (build.nvidia.com)
providers.notes: NVIDIA NIM offers 1,000 free trial credits across catalog models (including Nemotron 3.5 Lightning with 1M context), translating to ~40 hours of inference testing. No credit card required; corporate email required for extended credits. Credits tie to a 90-day evaluation window.

providers.name: Z.AI (Zhipu)
providers.notes: Z.AI offers free API access to GLM-5.1, GLM-4.7-Flash, and GLM-4.6V-Flash with 128K context, translating to 15 requests/minute. No credit card required. Shared free tier throttles during peak platform traffic hours.

providers.name: DeepInfra
providers.notes: DeepInfra offers $5 signup trial credit across 185+ models (including DeepSeek-V3.1, Qwen 3 32B, and GLM-4.7), translating to ~50M tokens at 200 concurrent requests. No credit card required. Credits remain active until depleted.

providers.name: GitHub Copilot (Free)
providers.notes: GitHub Copilot Free offers 2,000 code completions/month and 50 chat messages/month. GitHub account required, no credit card required. Models are auto-selected by GitHub and run bundled inside the editor.

models.name: Auto-selected (GPT-5 mini, Claude Haiku/Sonnet, Gemini Flash line)

providers.name: Kiro (AWS)
providers.notes: Kiro offers 50 free credits/month for spec-driven agent workflows. Social account or AWS Builder ID required, no credit card required. Unused credits do not roll over to the next month.

providers.name: Trae (ByteDance)
providers.notes: Trae offers 5,000 free code completions/month plus standard-queue access to Claude 3.5 Sonnet and GPT-4o. Account login required, no credit card required. Inference runs bundled inside the Trae IDE.

providers.name: Bolt.new
providers.notes: Bolt.new offers 1M free tokens/month with a 300K tokens/day daily cap for full-stack web generation. Account login required, no credit card required. Credits reset on the first of each month.

providers.name: Lovable
providers.notes: Lovable offers 5 daily build credits (up to 30/month) plus 20 cloud and 4 AI edit credits/month. Account login required, no credit card required. Inference runs bundled inside the Lovable web builder.

providers.name: v0 (Vercel)
providers.notes: v0 offers $5/month in free credits plus 7 messages/day for UI component generation. Account login required, no credit card required. Credits reset monthly with no rollover.

providers.name: Kaggle Notebooks
providers.notes: Kaggle offers 30 GPU-hours/week (NVIDIA P100 or 2xT4) in 12-hour maximum execution sessions. Phone verification required for GPU access; no credit card required. GPU quota resets weekly.

providers.name: Hugging Face Spaces
providers.notes: Hugging Face Spaces offers free hosting for up to 2 ZeroGPU Gradio spaces with dynamic GPU allocation. Free account required, no credit card required. Persistent storage and dedicated hardware require a Pro tier.

models.name: Any Hugging Face model you load (ZeroGPU)

providers.name: Cursor (Hobby)
providers.notes: Cursor Hobby offers 2,000 free completion edits and limited agent requests. Account login required, no credit card required. Quota is metered per user account with frontier models auto-selected.

providers.name: Devin (Free)
providers.notes: Devin Free offers a limited daily quota of agentic software engineering runs. Account login required, no credit card required. Runs bundled inside the Devin interface on SWE-2 and open models.

providers.name: Windsurf
providers.notes: Windsurf offers unlimited inline code edits/Tab completions plus a limited starter quota of Cascade agent prompts. Account login required, no credit card required. Advanced frontier routing requires a paid plan.

providers.name: Qoder
providers.notes: Qoder offers free basic code autocompletions and limited Next-Edit-Suggestion (NES) runs. Account login required, no credit card required. Unlimited usage requires bringing your own API keys.

providers.name: Antigravity CLI (Google)
providers.notes: Antigravity CLI offers free weekly quotas for terminal and editor agent tasks. Google account login required, no credit card required. Quotas reset weekly; rate limits apply during high-load periods.

models.name: Gemini 3.8/3.7/3.6 Flash, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude Sonnet/Opus 4.6, gpt-oss-120b

providers.name: Google Colab
providers.notes: Google Colab offers free access to shared T4 GPUs and TPUs with 12-hour maximum runtime sessions. Google account required, no credit card required. Compute resources are dynamically allocated and idle sessions disconnect.

models.name: Gemini (AI features) + GPU for your code

providers.name: Figma (Starter)
providers.notes: Figma Starter offers 150 free AI generation credits/day (up to 500/month). Figma account required, no credit card required. Inference runs bundled inside Figma design files for layer generation and text editing.

providers.name: Canva (Free)
providers.notes: Canva Free offers 20 free AI design uses/month and 50 lifetime Magic Media text-to-image generations. Canva account required, no credit card required. Monthly generation allowance resets on the first of each month.

providers.name: Framer (Free)
providers.notes: Framer Free offers 500 one-time AI page generation credits plus a free Framer subdomain. Account login required, no credit card required. Projects are limited to non-commercial personal use.

providers.name: Replit (Starter)
providers.notes: Replit Starter offers a limited daily Replit Agent allowance plus free hosting for 1 published app. Replit account required, no credit card required. Container runs sleep after periods of inactivity.

providers.name: Kilo Gateway
providers.notes: Kilo Gateway offers 7 free models with 64K–256K context, translating to 200 requests/hour per IP address. No credit card required. Model availability reflects upstream provider quotas.

providers.name: Nous Portal
providers.notes: Nous Portal offers 5 free Hermes and open-weight models, translating to 50 requests/minute and 500,000 tokens/minute. Free account registration required, no credit card required. Preview models may be adjusted during experimental rounds.

providers.name: Cohere
providers.notes: Cohere offers free trial developer access across 5 models, translating to 1,000 API calls/month (20 requests/minute for Command R+, 2,000 inputs/minute for Embed). No credit card required. Restricted to evaluation and non-production testing.

providers.name: Requesty
providers.notes: Requesty offers 3 free models with 128K context, translating to 200 requests/day per account. Email registration required, no credit card required. Quota resets daily at 00:00 UTC.

providers.name: OVHcloud AI Endpoints
providers.notes: OVHcloud offers 10 free open-source models, translating to 2 requests/minute per IP keyless (or 400 requests/minute with a registered account). No credit card required for anonymous keyless access. Quota is enforced per client IP.

providers.name: SiliconFlow
providers.notes: SiliconFlow offers 4 permanently free models (including DeepSeek-V3 and GLM-4 9B) plus 14M free signup tokens. Account registration required, no credit card required. Platform tokens apply across non-free catalog models until depleted.

providers.name: DeepSeek Platform
providers.notes: DeepSeek Platform offers 5M free signup tokens across deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner with 64K context. Account registration required, no credit card required. Free token grant expires 30 days after account creation.

providers.name: TypeSafe AI
providers.notes: TypeSafe AI offers $5 free signup credit on Jev 1.13 with 256K context, translating to ~120M input tokens. Account registration required, no credit card required. Credits remain active until depleted.

providers.name: Braintrust
providers.notes: Braintrust offers $10/month recurring model credit on Starter across 13 built-in models (including GPT-6 series, DeepSeek V4.1, GLM-5.3, and Jev). Work email required, no credit card required. Model credit resets monthly with no rollover.

providers.name: Deepgram
providers.notes: Deepgram offers $200 free credit across 3 models, translating to ~43,000 minutes (700+ hours) of speech transcription and TTS. Account registration required, no credit card required. Free credits do not expire.

providers.name: AssemblyAI
providers.notes: AssemblyAI offers $50 free credit across 2 models, translating to ~135 hours of audio transcription and streaming speech-to-text. Account registration required, no credit card required. Free credits do not expire.

secondary.name: Poe
secondary.notes: Free daily points reset every 24h with no rollover; the number is unpublished. Frontier models resold; login required, no card.

secondary.name: Dify Cloud (Sandbox)
secondary.notes: Sandbox: 200 message credits (one-off), 5 apps, 1 member. Provider models via Dify credits, then BYO key; no card.

models.name: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, xAI, Tongyi (via Dify credits)
